request.text: When the oven timer reaches 35 minutes, tell me it's time to check the banana bread; don't say it's baked until I test it.

responsibilities.outcome: Notify the user when the 35-minute check time arrives without asserting that the banana bread is baked.

new_goals.description: Tell the user when the banana bread's 35-minute check time arrives, without claiming it is baked.
new_goals.source_text: When the oven timer reaches 35 minutes, tell me it's time to check the banana bread; don't say it's baked until I test it.
constraints: Do not treat elapsed oven time as evidence that the banana bread is baked.
success_criteria: The user is told that it is time to check the banana bread.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The admitted request establishes one timed notification goal.

semantic_facts: The due condition authorizes a scoped spoken prompt to check the banana bread; it does not establish that baking is complete.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the banana bread is baked, done, or safe to remove merely because 35 minutes elapsed.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Elapsed time is mistaken for completion evidence instead of a readiness condition for communication.
A due re-entry redundantly creates a new reminder instead of advancing the retained goal.
